description: Delete the webhook endpoint and its delivery history, so we stop POSTing events. Events are still recorded, so list_events still answers. A signed-in owner can call this, or an API key with both setup and read permission. A key works only on a webhook a key saved: one a person saved answers 409 `webhookSavedByPerson`, so ask the owner with `create_handoff`, kind `manage_webhook`.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: delete_webhook
title: Delete the webhook endpoint
